For clarification, the technology and findings from this project are applicable across all industries, as invoice factoring is a $2.74 trillion market. The platform can easily be expanded to include various industries since the underlying technology is the same. For the sake of this proof of concept, we are showcasing film industry invoices.
Additionally, the testers, although part of Nucast, are not involved in the project team. As we develop the full-scale product, we plan to incorporate more external testers.
In the low Fidelity Prototype, the users, upon connecting their wallets, can view their invoice holdings, upcoming offers, Initial Invoice Public Offerings, matured and outstanding invoices. Additionally, a portfolio page displays all invoices in their wallets along with their performance.
